topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't believe this is happening. After everything, after all the preparations, a single delayed flight could unravel it all. I stand here, glued to the airport terminal, watching the minutes tick by like hours, each second a stark reminder of the irreparable loss of time. The event I had to be at, the connections I could have made, slipping through my fingers as if they were just dreams. The world outside the airport moves on, indifferent to the hours I'm stuck here, the opportunity fading. I try to call, to message, to find a solution, but the walls of this terminal feel like they're closing in, and my voice is nothing but a whisper against the noise of announcements and restless travelers.
